title: Todo User
description: Schema for user documents in the users Firestore collection.

display_name.description: The name displayed for the user.

photo_url.description: An optional URL for the user's profile photo.

uid.description: The Firebase Authentication UID for the user.

created_time.description: The Firestore timestamp when the user document was created.

phone_number.description: An optional phone number for the user.

birthdate.description: An optional birthdate stored as a Firestore timestamp.

age.description: An optional integer age for the user.
